title: An unexpected sign-in prompt — question explanation
learningObjective: Deny uninitiated authentication prompts and report repeated unexpected requests
format: 16:9 educational motion-graphics video; narration; separate captions; no autoplay with sound
visualStyle: Deep navy and charcoal; restrained cyan/electric-blue highlights; limited purple accents; clean typography; purposeful, low-motion transitions; accessible contrast.

scenes.name: Scenario setup
scenes.visual: You are not signing in, but your phone displays an approval request for your work account.
scenes.direction: Show a fictional simulated setting. Use generic UI and no actual organization, brand, user identity, credential, real URL or live account.

scenes.name: Learning objective and risk cue
scenes.visual: Deny uninitiated authentication prompts and report repeated unexpected requests
scenes.direction: Highlight only observable cues and explain the decision context without implying certainty beyond the scenario.

scenes.name: Recommended response
scenes.visual: Option B: Deny the request and report it to the helpdesk or security team. A prompt you did not initiate may indicate someone has your password or is attempting authentication.
scenes.direction: Animate the recommended defensive choice as a clear decision path. Display the action verb and trusted channel/control.

scenes.name: Why the other options fail
scenes.visual: Option A: Repeated prompts can be an authentication-fatigue tactic; approving a later one is unsafe. Option C: Public sharing may expose account identifiers or organizational information and does not report the incident appropriately. Option D: Approval may authorize an attacker’s login attempt.
scenes.direction: Show each unsafe alternative separately with a complete, concise reason. Do not depict operational exploitation, malicious code or credential capture.

scenes.name: Defensive takeaway
scenes.visual: Deny the request, do not disclose any code, and report unexpected or repeated prompts through the organization’s support channel. Only approve authentication you initiated and can confidently match to your sign-in.
scenes.direction: Close with one readable takeaway and the next safe action. Keep the final frame long enough for comprehension.
scenes.onScreenText: Only approve authentication you initiated and can confidently match to your sign-in.
